narrativeElements.localizedNarrativeDescription: A prodigious young player named Jian Zi-Hao is scouted by Royal Club to join the LPL. He dons the handle "Uzi" and makes his debut on March 16th, 2013. Uzi quickly ascends to stardom, becoming one of the most recognizable faces in League of Legends.

Uzi's unique approach to the ADC role completely redefines the way Bot lane is played. Despite his accolades and adoring fans, Uzi still has yet to lift a trophy domestically or internationally. The young pup embarks on a path of self-improvement.

Uzi has proven himself domestically as a mechanical god, but his lack of international trophies threatens to mar his legacy. As his skills improve, so do his placements. Will he finally achieve his goal of becoming an international champion?

After winning MSI and The Asian Games, Uzi retires due to health issues. Over the next several years, he dedicates himself to his physical fitness. Through hard work, Uzi overcomes his condition and becomes a marathon runner and athlete.

Streamer. Father. Athlete. Pro Gamer. Uzi's work ethic and commitment to progress helped him overcome the odds. Now in the present day, Uzi strives to lead a life fitting of the title "Icon of Continuous Growth.

Rasmus Borregaard Winther fell in love with gaming at a young age, thanks to the influence of his older brothers. Watching his hero Faker dominate inspired Rasmus to follow in his brother Christoffer's footsteps and pursue a career as a pro gamer.

Rasmus donned the handle "caPs" and began competing in various amateur leagues across Europe. Eventually, he was scouted by Fnatic and made his pro debut in 2017. In less than two years, he reached heights that most players only dream of.
Caps shocked the world by joining his rival Perkz on G2 Esports. They made history together in their first year as a team and laid the foundation for a legacy of domination.

As the years rolled on, Caps gradually embraced a leadership role on his team. He began mentoring the next generation of European talent, all while continuing to grow a trophy collection of historic magnitude.

At a time when the world doubted the west, Caps overcame the odds and redefined success. A career full of countless records broken and trophies lifted shaped Caps into the beloved Beacon of Hope we still know him as today.
